title: Long-Term Hardship Hold Extensions: Base Length by Payment Record
content:
**Decision table — Hardship and Protective Holds.** The base length of a long-term extension of a Long-Term Hardship Hold depends on the consumer's net voluntary payments on the held account in the last six months, read from that account's money history under Placed Consumer Accounts. The days the long-term extension adds are reckoned on this base length.

## The measure

Net voluntary payments mean payments posted less payments returned, each dated less than six whole months before today. Whole months are the difference in calendar months between the date and today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the date's day of the month.

## The table

| Net voluntary payments on the held account in that period | Base length of the long-term extension |
|---|---|
| At least the steady-payer amount of $150.00 | One review interval of the tier — 60 calendar days for the Long-Term Hardship Hold |
| Above zero but below $150.00 | The part-payer length of 75 calendar days |
| No net payments (zero or less) | The tier's extension days — 90 calendar days for the Long-Term Hardship Hold |

## Both sides of each threshold

| Net payments | Base length |
|---|---|
| $150.00 | 60 days |
| $149.99 | 75 days |
| $0.01 | 75 days |
| $0.00 | 90 days |
| $200.00 posted, $200.00 returned (net zero) | 90 days |

## Which payments fall inside six whole months (hypothetical dates)

Today is 15 September.

- A payment dated 16 March: the calendar months between March and September are 6, and today's day (15) is smaller than the payment's day (16), so the whole months are 5 — less than six, and the payment counts.
- A payment dated 15 March: 6 calendar months, and 15 is not smaller than 15, so the whole months are 6 — not less than six, and the payment does not count.
- A payment returned on 2 August counts against the payments posted in the period.

## Example (hypothetical)

In the period, $120.00 was posted on the held account and $40.00 of it was returned. Net voluntary payments are $80.00, above zero but below $150.00, so the base length is 75 calendar days.
